en.autoRetrieve: Auto-retrieve (pre-search user messages and inject relevant background)
en.autoRetrieveHint: When on, the model automatically uses knowledge-base content for factual questions without an explicit "knowledge base" mention; when off, only on-demand calls (knowledge_search tool + explicit requests)
en.autoRetrieveWeight: Auto-retrieve weight (chunks this base may contribute, 0 = excluded)
en.autoRetrieveWeightHint: A base contributes at most this many chunks per auto-retrieve injection (0–5, default 3); higher lets its content take more context, 0 excludes it entirely
en.bulkReindexNone: All selected documents are still processing — try again later
en.cacheDirHint: Embedding / rerank / OCR model files download here (~ and DSH_HOME are expanded). Note: "Save" only points the config here — it does NOT move files; use "Migrate models here" to move existing models.
en.cacheDirMigrated: Model cache migrated to {to} ({count} entries moved)
en.cacheDirMigrateNone: Nothing to migrate (source equals target, or the target already has the same entries)
en.cacheDirOpenUnavailable: Opening folders is unavailable in this environment; copy the path into your file manager
en.cacheDirPickUnavailable: Folder picking is unavailable (this environment has no directory picker)
en.cacheDirSaved: Cache directory saved (config only, files not moved; use "Migrate models here" to move existing models)
en.captionBaseUrlPlaceholder: API URL (leave empty to use the embedding model URL)
en.chunkChangeWarning: Chunking changes only apply to newly added content
en.chunkSeparatorHint: Delimiter the text is split on, in escaped form. With smart chunking on it adds a break point; with it off the text is split only by this delimiter.
en.chunkTokenLimitHint: Chunks above this token count split further at sentence/comma/space boundaries (0 = off); set within your local model's context window
en.confirmBulkDelete: Delete the selected {count} documents and all their chunks? This cannot be undone.
en.confirmCascadeBulkDelete: The selection contains non-empty directories, so deleting it removes their whole subtrees. The following will be permanently deleted:
en.confirmCascadeDelete: This directory has children, so deleting it removes the whole subtree. The following will be permanently deleted:
en.confirmDeleteBase: After deletion the knowledge base cannot be restored.
en.confirmDeleteDoc: Delete this document and all its chunks?
en.confirmDeleteGroup: After deletion, bases in this group will move to the default group.
en.conflictDialogMessage: {count} files share a name with items already in this base. How to proceed?
en.conflictMessage: Some sources have the same name as items already in this base. How to proceed?
en.conflictStrategyHint: When an imported file matches an existing name: rename (auto _1 suffix) / replace / keep both
en.customRerankAccept: I understand custom models are experimental and agree to run a local compatibility check after download
en.customRerankHint: Experimental: only Hugging Face ONNX sequence-classification models that need no remote custom code and return one logit are supported.
en.customRerankTitle: Advanced: add a custom local reranker
en.dirPlaceholder: Enter a local directory path, e.g. D:\docs\policy
en.docProcessingHint: Document preprocessing runs automatically during document import. Choosing the right provider can improve document parsing quality.
en.dragHint: Supports PDF, DOCX, MD, XLSX, TXT, CSV
en.embeddingModelMissingHint: The embedding provider is the local model, which is not downloaded yet — imported content cannot be vectorized for retrieval. Download the embedding model (~585MB) in Settings → Local Models first.
en.embeddingNotConfigured: This base has no embedding configured, so search is lexical only. Open Settings to pick an embedding model (OpenAI / Ollama / local), save, then reindex to enable semantic recall.
en.embeddingSwitchWarning: ⚠ Switching the embedding model invalidates this base's stored vectors, so the save will be refused — rebuild via “Rebuild base” with the new model instead (or empty the base first)
en.errorDimensionMismatch: Embedding dimension mismatch (model switched?) — rebuild the base with the new model
en.errorInterrupted: Import was interrupted by a shutdown — reindex to resume
en.evidenceEmpty: No structured evidence is available for this document.
en.fileTooLarge: "{name}" exceeds 22MB — cannot upload (the upload API caps at ~24MB); skipped
en.hfMirrorHint: When huggingface.co is unreachable, set a mirror (e.g. https://hf-mirror.com); takes effect immediately. Empty = official hub or the HF_ENDPOINT env var.
en.imageCaptionHint: Image/table captioning (optional): a vision model describes embedded PDF figures so charts become searchable
en.injectUsagePromptHint: Lists base names on each request; turning it off keeps tools and auto-retrieval available
en.lexicalOnlyHint: No embedding model configured — search is lexical only. Use the Settings button (top right) to configure an embedding model and enable semantic retrieval.
en.localModelErrorTitle: Local embedding model failed to load
en.localModelHint: In-process inference (transformers.js), no server needed; first use downloads the weights. Model = Hugging Face repo id, default onnx-community/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-ONNX
en.localModelNotReadyHint: Until it is ready, imports are keyword-searchable only. Download or check the local model.
en.localModelsDesc: Download, validate, and manage local embedding and rerank models. Only healthy rerankers appear in base settings.
en.localRerankTimeoutHint: Includes queue wait. On timeout, retrieval order is preserved and the stuck rerank process is isolated.
en.localWorkerIdleTimeoutMs: Local-model worker idle timeout (ms, 0 = keep models hot)
en.localWorkerIdleTimeoutMsHint: After this much idle time the local model is UNLOADED to free memory (~600MB) but the worker process stays alive — the onnxruntime binding is loaded once per process, so the Linux respawn failure ("Module did not self-register") cannot occur; the next request reloads from disk (~1s). 0 = keep models hot (fastest, costs resident memory)
en.mineruApplied: Global default updated. Existing per-base overrides still take precedence.
en.mineruBasic: Basic xB7 CPU OCR, tables and formulas
en.mineruConfirmPreparation: Creates an isolated Python environment in the chosen directory, installs MinerU 4.0.6 and dependencies from PyPI, downloads pinned models from Hugging Face, and parses a public test PDF. Total runtime size is unknown; allow additional disk space. Confirm acceptance of upstream software and model licenses. Existing parser settings will not switch automatically.
en.mineruDeployDescription: Optional isolated deployment. Embedding and reranking models are separate, and existing cloud API settings stay unchanged. Basic uses ONNX parsing models.
en.mineruDeployExisting: Existing MinerU model directory (optional, read-only verification)
en.mineruDeployIncomplete: Existing model files are missing or do not match their fingerprints. This directory will not be modified; choose a complete model directory or clear this option.
en.mineruDeployPreflightOnly: Preparation creates a Python environment in the dedicated directory, installs MinerU, and downloads its models. The parser currently used by your knowledge base will not switch automatically.
en.mineruDeploySpace: Insufficient space for model downloads and staging.
en.mineruDeployTitle: MinerU local parsing xB7 Deployment preflight
en.mineruDeployUnknownRuntime: Model files only. Python, runtime and dependency sizes are not yet known and are not included above.
en.mineruExternalCopy: External models are copied into managed storage; the source stays read-only. Reusing downloads still requires disk space for the copy.
en.mineruLocalDesc: Files are sent only to this self-hosted address. Install the service separately; this plugin does not download models or switch to cloud automatically. Parsing powered by MinerU.
en.mineruManagedPreview: Experimental managed deployment: Basic / ONNX only. Creates an isolated environment from the selected Python without modifying existing environments. Real-model and cross-platform acceptance are pending. Use an external service for Standard/Advanced.
en.mineruPythonSourceHint: Used only by the isolated MinerU environment. Defaults to official PyPI. Save and rerun preflight after changing it.
en.noDocsHint: Paste text, upload files, or import a URL to get started
en.noLocalModelsReady: No downloaded local models — download one in Settings → Local Models
en.noOllamaModels: No installed Ollama models — pull one in Settings → Local Models
en.noSupportedFiles: No supported files in the selection (hidden files and unsupported formats are skipped)
en.ocrDesc: Download the PaddleOCR models (~25MB, full Chinese recognition); scanned PDFs (no text layer) are then OCRed automatically and indexed
en.ollamaDelete: Delete this model (fails while Ollama is running it)
en.ollamaDesc: Pull models through the Ollama API (embeddings, VLMs); pulled models are selectable in the base settings (provider: Ollama). Requires Ollama to be installed and running: https://ollama.com/download
en.ollamaEmbeddingHint: Embedding model — pick provider Ollama in the base settings and fill this name
en.ollamaInstalledTitle: Installed models (click a name to fill the input)
en.ollamaNeedInstall: (Tip: if connections keep failing, make sure Ollama is installed and running, or check the address above)
en.ollamaRecommended: Recommended models (click to fill, then pull)
en.ollamaUnreachable: Cannot reach Ollama (check the address or whether it is running)
en.ollamaVisionHint: Vision model — pick Ollama for image captioning in the base settings and fill this name
en.pathDesc: Absolute path to a directory or file
en.pdfTooLarge: File exceeds 100MB — cannot preview inline; download it to view
en.perBaseHint: Leave empty to use global settings
en.previewTruncated: Content too large; showing the first {count} characters.
en.processorBuiltin: Built-in parser (PDF / DOCX / PPTX / XLSX / EPUB / HTML / text)
en.processorBuiltinDesc: Built-in processor: parses every supported format locally; scanned PDFs are OCRed automatically once the OCR models are downloaded (Settings → Local Models)
en.processorCheckSaved: Save processor changes before testing. This checks capabilities without uploading a file.
en.processorMineruDesc: PDFs are uploaded to the configured MinerU cloud service. Failures may fall back to local parsing with a recorded warning. Get an API key at mineru.net.
en.pythonHint: Detection does not install software. Requires stable 64-bit CPython 3.10–3.14 with venv and ensurepip. Eligibility does not verify MinerU dependencies or parsing.
en.pythonLimited: Discovery reached its limit. Specify other environments manually.
en.pythonMissing: No eligible environment found. Enter a Python executable path and verify it.
en.pythonReasonProbe: Could not start interpreter or read its details
en.pythonRefreshHint: Restored from browser settings. Rescan before deployment to confirm the interpreter is still available.
en.rebuildHint: The embedding model has changed; existing vectors no longer match. Rebuild the base to regenerate vectors.
en.recallEmptyDesc: Results will show matching document chunks and scores
en.recallEmptyTitle: Enter a query to start the recall test
en.rerankHint: Model used to rerank initial retrieval results and improve final chunk relevance.
en.restoreHint: A new base will be created and all documents re-indexed. Optionally switch the embedding model (rebuild-with-new-model).
en.resumeInterruptedHint: When off, imports interrupted by a shutdown are marked failed instead of auto re-embedding (Cherry Studio behavior)
en.rrfVectorWeightHint: Relative weight of the vector lane in hybrid fusion (0.1–5, 1=balanced; raise for semantic questions)
en.semanticChunkHint: Embed paragraphs and merge adjacent similar ones (needs an embedding provider; off = heading/paragraph chunking)
en.semanticChunkThresholdHint: Start a new chunk when adjacent segments fall below this cosine (default 0.75); higher = smaller, more focused chunks
en.siblingChunksHint: Neighbouring chunks (xB1) attached to each hit (0–3, 0=off; gives answers the full paragraph)
en.smartChunkHint: Automatically split along Markdown structure (headings, code blocks, paragraphs) and never split inside a code block. Turn off to split purely by the separator.
en.statsSourceDocsTitle: Items tracked from the source (folders + files)
en.statsStoredDocsTitle: Documents actually parsed and stored as raw copies in the cache
en.structuredChunkingHint: Preserve tables, formulas and captions in structured documents; ordinary text keeps its existing chunking behavior.
en.thresholdHint: Similarity threshold used to filter low-relevance reranked chunks; higher is stricter.
en.tooManyFiles: At most {count} files per selection; split the import
en.topKHint: Maximum number of document chunks returned for each retrieval. Higher values cover more content but use more context.
en.uploadButton: Click to select files or drag them here
en.urlHelp: The page text will be fetched and indexed automatically
en.urlRefreshHoursHint: URL documents older than this are re-fetched and re-indexed hourly (0 = off)
